title: Training Note: Insurance Appeal Cushion on Portal Credit-Card Payments, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Training note for collectors on **Placed Consumer Accounts**: the portal credit-card appeal cushion, which follows from insurance denial rebills and insurance payment credits on the account.

## The rule

The portal credit-card appeal cushion is:
- **$120.00** where an insurance denial rebill was added to the account in the last six months and an insurance payment credit has been booked on the account;
- **$60.00** where an insurance denial rebill was added in the last six months and no insurance payment credit has been booked on the account;
- **nothing** where no insurance denial rebill was added in the last six months.

The cushion is subtracted, at its full amount, in working out the portal credit-card ceiling of the day.

## Questions and answers

**What is an insurance denial rebill?** A supplemental addition on the account's money history whose reason is insurance denial rebill.

**What is an insurance payment credit?** A client credit on the account's money history whose reason is insurance payment.

**Which dates matter?** For the rebill, its date must fall in the last six months, meaning fewer than six whole calendar months between that date and the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. For the insurance payment credit, no window applies: any such credit ever booked on the account counts.

**Does an insurance payment credit alone give a cushion?** No. Without a rebill in the last six months the cushion is nothing.

## Condition table

| Insurance denial rebill in the last six months | Insurance payment credit ever booked | Cushion |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | $120.00 |
| Yes | No | $60.00 |
| No | either | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented medical accounts, handling date 2026-10-10.*

- Rebill added 2026-06-03; insurance payment credit booked 2025-12-01. Cushion $120.00.
- Rebill added 2026-06-03; no insurance payment credit ever. Cushion $60.00.
- Rebill added 2026-04-10 (six whole months back); insurance payment credit booked 2026-09-01. Cushion nothing.
